notes: These test cases require workspace state setup. Recovery now treats fix-plan.md and fix-report.md as optional signals; branch, diff, spec.md, plan.md, review artifacts, and pipeline state are also valid recovery signals.

evals.name: bugfix-mid-fix-with-plan
evals.prompt: My session broke, help me recover
evals.expected_output: Should auto-detect bug-fix-workflow from fix/B-001-* branch. Should detect fix-plan.md + code changes as optional plan signal plus implementation diff -> infer Review. Should display recovery report with workflow type, phase, artifacts, and code stats. Should ask recovery approach before invoking /prizmkit-code-review or recovery script.
evals.setup_description: Create fix/B-001-login-crash branch, optional .prizmkit/bugfix/B-001/fix-plan.md, modify 3 source files + 1 test file. No fix-report.md, no commits ahead of main.

evals.name: bugfix-diff-no-fix-plan
evals.expected_output: Should auto-detect bug-fix-workflow from fix/B-002-* branch even without fix-plan.md. Code/test changes should infer Review. Should not require .prizmkit/bugfix/B-002/fix-plan.md to exist.
evals.setup_description: Create fix/B-002-null-pointer branch and modify 2 source files + 1 test file. No .prizmkit/bugfix/B-002 directory, no fix-plan.md, no fix-report.md.

evals.name: bugfix-plan-only
evals.expected_output: Should auto-detect bug-fix-workflow from fix/B-003-* branch. Should detect spec.md or plan.md but no code changes -> infer Fix. Should read the plan artifact and resume implementation only after user chooses interactive recovery.
evals.setup_description: Create fix/B-003-null-pointer branch with spec.md and plan.md. No code changes.

evals.name: feature-list-exists
evals.expected_output: Should auto-detect feature-workflow from .prizmkit/plans/feature-list.json. Should detect list exists but no pipeline state -> infer Launch. Should ask recovery approach; launcher handoff is valid after user selection.
evals.setup_description: On main branch, create .prizmkit/plans/feature-list.json with 3 features. No .prizmkit/state/features/ directory.

evals.name: refactor-monitoring
evals.prompt: pick up where it left off
evals.expected_output: Should auto-detect refactor-workflow from .prizmkit/plans/refactor-list.json + pipeline state. Should infer Monitor / Recover Pipeline. Should ask whether to run recovery script, resume interactively, clean retry, or start fresh.
evals.setup_description: On main branch, create .prizmkit/plans/refactor-list.json with 2 items. Create .prizmkit/state/refactor/ with status files showing 1 completed, 1 in-progress.

evals.name: no-workflow-detected
evals.expected_output: Should detect no workflow signatures in workspace. Should display guidance suggesting /feature-workflow, /bug-fix-workflow, or /refactor-workflow. Should NOT attempt recovery actions.
evals.setup_description: Clean workspace on main branch. No .prizmkit/plans/*.json files, no pipeline state, no fix/* or feat/* or refactor/* branch, no spec.md or plan.md.
